title: IT Technical Project Manager
description:
**IT Technical Project Manager**

**Experience:** 4 Years  
**Company:** Kretoss Technology LLP  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Note:** Only Gujarat\-based candidates can apply.

About the Role

Kretoss Technology LLP is looking for an experienced **IT Technical Project Manager** with 4\+ years of experience in managing software development projects, technical teams, clients, timelines, and project delivery. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of software development processes and the ability to coordinate effectively between clients, developers, QA, UI/UX, and management.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage **end\-to\-end IT/software development projects** from requirement gathering to final delivery.
* Understand project requirements, define scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
* Coordinate with **developers, QA, UI/UX designers, business teams, and clients** to ensure smooth project execution.
* Convert business requirements into clear technical tasks and project plans.
* Prepare and maintain **project schedules, task assignments, timelines, and priorities**.
* Track daily project progress and ensure tasks are completed within agreed deadlines.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and resource constraints and take corrective actions.
* Conduct regular **project status meetings** and provide progress updates to management and clients.
* Communicate effectively with clients regarding requirements, progress, changes, issues, and delivery timelines.
* Manage **scope changes, change requests, and project priorities** while maintaining delivery commitments.
* Work closely with technical teams to understand architecture, development challenges, integrations, APIs, databases, deployments, and technical dependencies.
* Ensure proper coordination between **development and QA teams** for testing, bug fixing, UAT, and final deployment.
* Monitor project quality and ensure development follows defined technical and business standards.
* Review project documentation, requirements, estimates, and deliverables.
* Maintain proper project documentation including **BRD/FRD, SRS, project plans, meeting notes, status reports, and delivery documents**.
* Ensure timely deployment and successful project handover to the client.
* Monitor post\-production issues and coordinate with technical teams for timely resolution.
* Support management in **resource planning, project estimation, and team allocation**.
* Identify opportunities to improve project processes, productivity, and delivery efficiency.

Technical Knowledge Required

* Strong understanding of **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**.
* Good understanding of **Agile / Scrum methodologies**.
* Experience working with project management tools such as **Jira, Trello, ClickUp, Asana, or similar platforms**.
* Understanding of **Web Applications, Mobile Applications, APIs, Databases, and Cloud environments**.
* Basic understanding of technologies such as **.NET, PHP/Laravel, Node.js, React/Angular, Flutter/iOS/Android, Shopify**, or similar development technologies.
* Understanding of **REST APIs, third\-party integrations, databases, Git, deployment, and CI/CD**.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and communicate them effectively to development teams.
* Basic understanding of **AWS/Azure/Cloud platforms** is an advantage.
* Understanding of **QA processes, testing, bug tracking, UAT, and production releases**.

Key Requirements

* **4\+ years of experience** in IT Project Management / Technical Project Management.
* Proven experience managing **software development projects from initiation to delivery**.
* Strong experience in **client communication and stakeholder management**.
* Excellent project planning, task management, prioritization, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of technical concepts and software development processes.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to identify project risks and take proactive corrective actions.
* Strong leadership and team coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of project delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to deadlines.
* Experience working with **international clients** will be an added advantage.

Must\-Have Skills

**Project Management \| SDLC \| Agile/Scrum \| Client Communication \| Team Management \| Requirement Gathering \| Project Planning \| Risk Management \| Jira/Project Management Tools \| Technical Understanding \| QA \& UAT \| API \& Integration Understanding \| Deployment \& Production Support**

Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on Technical Project Manager**, not only a task coordinator. The candidate must be comfortable communicating with clients as well as developers, understanding technical challenges, managing project priorities, and taking ownership of **end\-to\-end project delivery**.

Pay: From ₹60,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Project Manager – ERP Implementations
description:
##### ***Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar (on\-site), Gujarat******,*** ***India***

  

#### **About the Role**

  

Silent Infotech is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation, delivery, transformation, upgrade, migration, integration, and go\-live programs for international customers. The role requires strong ownership of scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, stakeholder communication, and cross\-functional coordination across functional consultants, developers, QA, DevOps, support teams, and customer stakeholders. Hands\-on experience delivering ERP projects is mandatory. Experience with Odoo ERP is an added advantage.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of ERP implementation projects from discovery and planning through configuration, development, integration, data migration, UAT, go\-live, hypercare, and handover.
* Manage ERP transformation programs involving process redesign, legacy\-system replacement, phased rollouts, upgrades, migrations, and multi\-module implementations.
* Translate customer business requirements into structured project scope, milestones, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate functional consultants, technical teams, developers, QA, DevOps, integration teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure aligned and timely delivery.
* Manage project scope, timelines, resource allocation, budgets/effort, dependencies, change requests, risks, issues, and escalations.
* Lead customer meetings including project kick\-offs, requirement reviews, steering/status meetings, UAT reviews, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live support reviews.
* Ensure strong governance through project plans, RAID logs, action trackers, status reports, meeting minutes, documentation, and delivery dashboards.
* Drive fit\-gap analysis and ensure clear decisions between standard ERP functionality, configuration, customization, integration, and process change.
* Manage third\-party integrations, APIs, middleware dependencies, data migration activities, and coordination with external vendors where applicable.
* Plan and govern SIT/UAT cycles, defect resolution, cutover planning, go\-live checklists, rollback/contingency planning, and production readiness.
* Provide live customer interaction and leadership during critical go\-live, hypercare, production support, and escalation situations.
* Identify delivery risks early, establish mitigation plans, remove blockers, and escalate decisions to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensure projects meet agreed quality standards, contractual commitments, customer expectations, and internal delivery processes.
* Support presales and solution teams when required with project estimation, implementation approach, delivery timelines, resource planning, and proposal/RFP inputs.
* Mentor project coordinators and team members and contribute to continuous improvement of ERP delivery practices.

#### **Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Strong ERP project/program management experience across proprietary and/or open\-source ERP platforms.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, Odoo, ERPNext, or comparable enterprise systems.
* Ability to understand both functional business processes and technical delivery dependencies including integrations, APIs, data migration, environments, and deployments.
* Strong stakeholder management, customer communication, negotiation, conflict resolution, and escalation\-handling skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, dependencies, and teams while maintaining delivery visibility and accountability.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills, including project plans, RAID logs, status reports, effort tracking, action registers, and executive updates.
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Odoo Project, MS Project, or equivalent is a plus
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Business, Management, or equivalent practical experience.

#### **Good to Have**

  

* Valid US Business(B1/B2\) visa.
* Prior onsite travel history for customer meetings, discovery, implementation, training, or go\-live activities.
* Experience interacting directly with US, European, Middle East, or other international customers.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, ITIL, or ERP\-vendor certifications.
* Experience in manufacturing, distribution, retail, services, accounting, CRM, supply chain, or other ERP\-intensive business domains.
* Willingness to travel onsite internationally based on project requirements.

description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat


**Job Type:** Full Time


**Department:** Project management


**About Simform:**


Simform is a premier digital engineering company specialising in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. Simform is well\-recognised as one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work\-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.


**Role Overview:** We are a digital product engineering company that partners with clients to create innovative, high\-performing software solutions. We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager who can lead from the front—bridging the gap between business and technology while ensuring smooth project execution..


**Key Responsibilities**:


* **End\-to\-End Delivery** — Own project delivery from planning and estimation through execution, release, and continuous improvement.
* **Technical Solutioning** — Provide technical guidance on system design, architecture, web, mobile, and scalable cloud solutions across Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* **Agile/Scrum Leadership** — Lead Agile ceremonies, sprint execution, backlog management, and delivery planning to ensure predictable outcomes.
* **Requirements Management** — Translate client/business needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable deliverables.
* **Team Leadership \& Mentorship** — Lead and mentor cross\-functional teams including PMs, BAs, engineers, QA, architects, and UX/UI professionals.
* **Client \& Stakeholder Management** — Build strong relationships with overseas clients and senior stakeholders, providing clear updates and managing expectations.
* **Architecture \& Technical Oversight** — Guide architectural decisions, engineering practices, integrations, performance, security, and overall solution quality.
* **AI\-First Delivery** — Leverage AI tools, automation, and accelerators across the SDLC to improve productivity, quality, speed, and predictability.
* **Quality \& Release Management** — Oversee testing, defect resolution, release planning, deployment readiness, and application performance.
* **Delivery Governance** — Drive estimation, planning, risk management, change control, resource utilization, billability, and delivery metrics.
* **Scope \& Escalation Management** — Handle scope changes, delivery challenges, commercial discussions, and escalations with sound judgment and composure.
* **UX \& Continuous Improvement** — Collaborate with UX/design teams and continuously improve processes, engineering practices, and customer outcomes.

**Must Have**:


* Strong experience in **technical project/delivery management and solution leadership**.
* Hands\-on knowledge of **system design, architecture, cloud, web, mobile, and modern engineering practices**.
* Proven experience leading **Agile/Scrum teams and complex end\-to\-end projects**.
* Excellent **client communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and escalation\-handling skills**.
* Strong understanding of **estimation, governance, risk, scope, quality, and delivery metrics**.
* Ability to lead and mentor **cross\-functional technical and non\-technical teams**.
* Strong **AI\-first mindset** with practical experience applying AI and automation across the SDLC.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of technical experience, working withData Engineering technologies and understanding their core concepts.
* Proven leadership in managing and mentoring teams to successfully deliver projects.
* Expertise in Agile/SCRUM methodologies for medium\-to\-large scale applications.
* Strong interpersonal skills – mentoring, coaching, collaborating, and building high\-performing teams.
* Problem\-solving mindset – ability to zoom into details while keeping the big picture in focus.
* Solid grasp of design patterns and software architecture best practices.
* Hands\-on experience managing projects from concept to production deployment.

**Why Join Us:**


* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flat\-hierarchical, friendly, engineering\-oriented, and growth\-focused culture.
* Well\-balanced learning and growth opportunities
* Free health insurance.
* Office facilities with a game zone, in\-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options

title: Project Manager
description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.



For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward.



\#


### **Senior Project Manager – HVAC (Chillers)**


**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat **Department:** Operations / Project Management **Experience:** 12\-18 Years **Industry:** HVAC, Building Solutions, Chillers, MEP Projects


### **Job Summary**



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager \- HVAC** to lead and manage end\-to\-end execution of large\-scale HVAC and Chiller projects. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in **HVAC systems, Chillers, project execution, project management, stakeholder management, and commercial aspects of projects**. The role requires ensuring timely project delivery, quality compliance, customer satisfaction, and profitability.


### **Key Responsibilities**


### **Project Management \& Execution**


* Lead multiple HVAC and Chiller projects from initiation to commissioning and handover.
* Develop project execution plans, schedules, resource allocation plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per contractual requirements.
* Monitor project progress and resolve technical, commercial, and operational issues.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

### **Technical Management**


* Oversee installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of HVAC and Chiller systems.
* Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with HVAC industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements.
* Provide technical guidance to project engineers and site teams.

### **Customer \& Stakeholder Management**


* Act as the primary point of contact for customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage client expectations, change requests, and escalation handling.

### **Commercial \& Financial Management**


* Monitor project budgets, costs, cash flow, and profitability.
* Review project variations, claims, and billing milestones.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and project closure.

### **Team Leadership**


* Lead and mentor project managers, engineers, and site execution teams.
* Drive performance, productivity, and accountability across project teams.
* Promote a culture of safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

### **EHS \& Quality Compliance**


* Ensure adherence to EHS standards and organizational safety policies.
* Drive quality control processes throughout project execution.
* Conduct audits and corrective actions to ensure compliance.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* PMP/Prince2 certification will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of HVAC systems, Chillers, Air Handling Units (AHU), Cooling Towers, Pumps, and Building Automation Systems.

### **Required Experience**


* 12\-18 years of experience in HVAC/Chiller project execution and project management.
* Proven track record of managing large commercial, industrial, healthcare, pharmaceutical, data center, or infrastructure projects.
* Hands\-on experience in Chiller installation, commissioning, and lifecycle project management.
* Experience managing project teams, contractors, consultants, and customers.

### **Key Skills**


* HVAC Project Management
* Chiller Systems
* Project Execution
* Project Planning \& Scheduling
* Contract Management
* Cost Control \& Budgeting
* Stakeholder Management
* Risk Management
* Installation \& Commissioning
* MEP Projects
* EHS Compliance
* Team Leadership
* Customer Relationship Management

### **Preferred Industry Background**



Candidates from HVAC, Building Technologies, MEP Contracting, Chiller Manufacturing, Industrial Cooling, Data Centers, Pharmaceuticals, Commercial Buildings, or Infrastructure Projects will be preferred.
